office.title: About the International Office
office.description: The office coordinates the university’s external relations, student and staff mobility, and partnership agreements.
office.p1: The International Office is the structure responsible for Saribekyan International Medical University’s external collaboration. It maintains links with partner universities, education networks, and international programmes.
office.p2: The office supports international applicants and students, organises exchanges, manages memoranda of understanding, and assists joint academic and research projects.
